content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

§ 12.4 imposes a 24-month post-term, worldwide, undefined-scope non-compete on Juniper Ridge — squarely in walk-away territory under NONCOMPETE (post-term restriction >12 months and "competes with Vendor in any territory"). It binds our party, not Cobalt, and it flatly contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor already acknowledges Customer has made no non-compete commitment.

Redline: delete p0046 (§ 12.4) in full — validated ok:true. Comment notes the playbook position and offers the fallback (named competing product, term only, ≤12 months, with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs) if Cobalt pushes back.
